rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Labels and overlines must be uppercase, tiny, and have wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use varied weights to create tension (e.g., font-black for H1, font-light for subheadings).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard with a focus on generous padding: p-4, p-6, p-8 for cards; p-16, p-24, p-32 for web sections.

web_grid.marketing_hero: Bento Grid or Asymmetrical overlap (col-span-8 and col-span-4).
web_grid.features: Gridcols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6 or gap-8.

mobile_layout.padding: px-4 or px-6 universally for horizontal constraints.
mobile_layout.bottom_nav_offset: pb-24 to account for fixed bottom navigation.

rules: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for web marketing layouts to achieve asymmetry.
Card components must use internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

glassmorphism.classes: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]

cards.classes: bg-[#141414] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300

tracing_beam.description: Dynamic border glow using framer-motion or CSS mask-image.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Always elevate cards (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity on hover.
motion_and_interaction.buttons: Active states must scale down slightly (scale-95).
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Smooth fade and slide up (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 10px to 0).
motion_and_interaction.lesson_swipe: Framer Motion (React) or Reanimated (Expo) to handle tinder-like swipe left/right for micro-lessons.

marketing_web_page.hero: Dark cinematic hero. Massive h1 text. Minimalist workspace/tech image with a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent).
marketing_web_page.features: Bento grid layout showing app screenshots or mockups.
marketing_web_page.pricing: 3 cards. 'Pro' card highlighted with tracing beam/glow effect.

mobile_onboarding.flow: Value-first welcome -> 2 preference questions (Goal: Career/Business/Creator/Productivity) -> Signup -> Start Path.
mobile_onboarding.ui: Progressive disclosure. High contrast typography. Large selectable cards for preferences.

mobile_home_paths.header: User streak (flame icon + amber text) and profile avatar.
mobile_home_paths.content: Bento grid. 'Continue Learning' main large card. 'Explore Paths' horizontal scroll.

mobile_lesson_player.ui: Immersive full-screen swiping cards. Progress bar pinned to top. Text content with animated interactive elements. Quiz at the end.
mobile_lesson_player.interactions: Swipe to go to next card. Tap to reveal answers.

mobile_ai_tutor.ui: Chat interface. Dark mode. AI messages in surface color, User messages in brand color/dark text or elevated surface.
mobile_ai_tutor.avatar: Professional, slightly abstract avatar for the AI.

mobile_model_library.ui: 2-column grid of cards. Each card has a subtle glow matching the model's brand color (e.g., green for ChatGPT, purple for Claude, etc.), contained within the dark theme.

web_hero_bg.description: Abstract composition showcasing modern architectural elements with dramatic lighting.

path_business_thumbnail.description: Minimalist setup featuring a laptop and smartphone.

path_creator_thumbnail.description: Modern architectural facade with abstract patterns.

ai_tutor_avatar.description: Professional avatar for the AI Tutor.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React Expo with Expo Router for mobile app. Next.js or React Router for web marketing page route.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards against the dark background. Use focus rings for web navigation.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_components: Use custom styled components for React Native/Expo, mapping Tailwind design system variables to StyleSheet or Nativewind. For Web, use Shadcn UI highly customized to match the dark luxury theme.
